variables.name: icebreaker
variables.fallback: Reaching out because {company_name} fits a pattern we see across {company_industry} teams.

variables.name: custom_angle
variables.prompt: In 1-2 sentences, write the most relevant pitch angle for selling [PRODUCT] to {company_name}, given they are a {company_industry} company with around {company_employee_count} employees. Be specific about which pain point likely matters most to a {title}. No fluff.

variables.name: fit_score
variables.prompt: Score the cold-email fit of {company_name} (industry: {company_industry}, size: {company_employee_count}) for our offer on a scale of high / medium / low. Output ONLY one of: high, medium, low.
